3.measure_note: legacy_colAB Schedule A is an UNDERLINE form: rowbands.py returns 17 per-column underline rules (fill 0.95, 4 segments each) at 19.19, 23.28, 27.36, ... with a regular pitch of 4.08, and the four segments ARE the column bands (Date 6.85-18.80, Name 20.39-53.94, Address 55.47-83.01, Amount 84.48-94.61). THE TEXT SITS ABOVE ITS UNDERLINE, so row N spans [rule N-1, rule N]; row 1 has no rule above it and its band is extrapolated one pitch up from the first detected rule at 19.19, giving [15.11, 19.19]. TWO-CROP PROOF at 900 dpi (only 2 rows are filled, so BOTH were proved): the row-1 box pct:84.48,15.11,10.13,4.08@p3 rendered the handwritten '2,000.00' (with the printed 'Amount' column header above it, since the extrapolated band reaches into the header strip) and the row-2 box pct:84.48,19.19,10.13,4.09@p3 rendered '23.08' with the tail of row 1 above the intervening rule — the bands are not off by one. Rules 3-17 are the blank ruled lines of the unused schedule and carry no entries.
